long_description.before:
💼 Augment builds AI-powered tools to automate company operations, starting with Roger—an intelligent CRM that acts as your AI-powered sales team. 💼

🚀 Built by experienced founders and backed by Y Combinator, Augment is redefining sales automation with AI-driven workflows that handle prospecting, outreach, and deal management—so businesses can scale effortlessly.

How it Works – 

Roger, Your AI-Powered CRM

📊 A CRM That Works for You

Unlike traditional CRMs that require constant manual updates, Roger actively manages your sales pipeline. It tracks interactions, follows up with leads, and keeps your team focused on closing deals instead of admin work.

🤖 AI-Powered Outreach & Engagement

Roger automates lead generation and crafts personalized outreach messages across email, LinkedIn, and other channels. It continuously refines its approach based on engagement data to increase conversions.

🎯 Smart Deal Management

Roger qualifies leads, schedules follow-ups, and moves deals through your pipeline automatically. It ensures your team never drops the ball on a potential customer.

📈 Seamless Integration & Insights

Roger syncs with your existing tools, updating your sales data in real-time. AI-powered analytics provide actionable insights, helping teams optimize sales strategies. By automating tedious sales tasks and making CRM proactive instead of passive, Roger turns AI into your most efficient sales teammate—helping businesses close more deals, faster.

one_liner.before: Roger is an AI SDR that automates outbound sales and follows up 24/7.

long_description.before:
We build modular humanoid robots and the software platform that allows anyone to train, deploy, and scale robots for real-world tasks.

Today, teaching a robot a new skill requires robotics engineers, machine learning engineers, training infrastructure, and significant compute resources. We reduce that process to:
Record → Upload → Train → Deploy.

Our robots are modular and configurable, with interchangeable end effectors, configurable sensors, and multiple deployment configurations. 

We believe current humanoid embodiments are often overfit for specific use cases, so we're building a platform that adapts to different environments and applications.

Long term, we want robotics to be as accessible as software development. Our goal is to become the default platform for training and deploying autonomous robots.
long_description.after:
We build verifiable reinforcement-learning environments, evaluations, and proprietary training datasets to improve frontier AI models and robot policies.

We focus on complex, underexplored domains like PCB and chip design, embedded systems, robotics, and specialized coding environments, where high-quality training data is scarce and existing models fall short.

Our long-term goal is to develop self-improving training infrastructure that can autonomously generate increasingly challenging tasks, evaluate performance, and continuously advance model capabilities toward recursive self-improvement.

long_description.before:
Levocred AI is the Bloomberg of loans: AI agents that run and price a lender's book. One fund cut the time to mark its book from a week to two hours and now names us as data agent, the system of record, in its loan purchase agreements.

$22T of US loans never trade because nobody can price them efficiently and defensibly. We fix pricing first by deploying inside lenders. Trading follows, the way it did for bonds.
long_description.after: Levocred AI build AI employees for lenders including credit funds, fintechs, credit unions & banks to automate operations like servicing/collections, underwriting, back-office tasks etc.

long_description.before:
Altair is an AI-native medical billing service for independent practices. We take over a practice's billing end to end and get doctors paid by insurers. AI does the work; our billers handle the exceptions.

That can only work if a practice can trust an agent alone with its revenue. So we formalized insurers' billing policies and put a theorem prover under the agent. Before the agent acts on a claim, the prover checks the action against that insurer's policies, and anything that fails goes to one of our billers. 

Every claim teaches Altair how each insurer behaves, so the longer we run a practice's billing, the better we predict what its insurers will pay, deny or delay.

We're building the default way a new practice gets paid: a doctor connects their EHR and bills clean from the first patient, completely self-serve and on auto-pilot.

Altair will be the financial platform every independent practice in America starts on and stays on.

long_description.before:
Workers IO is building deterministic simulation environments to verify mission-critical software. We run your entire system through millions of production scenarios and prove that its properties hold in every one.

The problem:

Coding agents write code faster than teams can review it. At the same time, software and the infrastructure under it grow more complex every year. Tests only checks a few cases someone wrote, in isolation, in an environment that does not match production. Making the most expensive failures reach production first.

Our solution:

We run your system unmodified in our simulation environments, against network partitions, disk failures, crashes, and clock drift. We build those fault models for you and verify every promise across millions of scenarios. Because these simulations are deterministic, every failure is perfectly reproducible. No one writes scenarios by hand, so verification becomes a compute problem.
long_description.after:
Workers IO is building simulation environments to catch failures in mission-critical software before they reach production. We run your entire system through millions of simulated production scenarios to verify its correctness and performance properties.

Coding agents can now generate code faster than teams can review it. Meanwhile, software and the infrastructure it runs on keep getting more complex. Tests check a small set of cases in isolation, in environments that are different from production. Some of the most expensive failures only surface when customers encounter them.

We run your entire system unmodified and simulate network faults, disk failures, crashes, and clock drift. We build the fault models for you and check your system’s requirements across millions of scenarios. Every failure we find can be perfectly reproduced.

one_liner.before: API simulators for testing and training agents locally
one_liner.after: Train models and test agents in high-fidelity simulated environments

long_description.before:
Papaya is the optimization engine for AI agents. Engineers don't have time to continually improve the agents they've shipped — the context bloat, overly chatty subagents, and broken tool calls sit in production traces nobody reads, quietly hurting agent efficiency. With Papaya they connect their agent directly via SDK, get actionable recommendations on how to improve quality, latency, and cost, and the ones they approve are pushed to production as pull requests.

Papaya runs 200+ research-backed analyses across context, prompts, prompt caching, subagents, and tool calls. Every recommendation is ranked by impact and comes with the production runs that produced it — typically a 10%+ quality improvement on the first workflow analysis.
